page: Amazon Web Services m8gd.metal-24xl is a bare-metal general-purpose server powered by 96 dedicated physical cores of the ARM64 AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 processor. Operating at 2.8 GHz, this ARMv9-based system features 384 GB of DDR5 memory, providing a balanced 4 GB of RAM per core. The server includes 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Benchmark data shows top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 481.33 GB/sec for large block read-only operations. The system also excels in database operations, achieving 200.33 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and top-tier results in Passmark database tests. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the average and strong categories, respectively.

While multi-threaded tasks like software compilation, ray tracing, and database operations perform exceptionally well, certain workloads show limitations. Specifically, LLM text generation for small models registers in the bottom 10%, though medium and large model text generation remains strong. Given the high density of dedicated physical cores and fast local NVMe storage, this server is highly cost-efficient for multi-threaded enterprise applications, large-scale database hosting, static web serving, and parallelized CI/CD pipelines.
